name: cleantempmail-workspace
description: Self-hosted multi-domain mailbox on Cloudflare Workers (Email Routing + Email Sending / Resend)

DB.description: D1 database for message metadata, threads, search index and settings.

MAIL.description: R2 bucket for raw messages and attachments. **R2 must be enabled on your account** (free tier available).

WORKER_NAME.description: Name of this Worker, used by the catch-all rule. Leave it as is: if you rename the Worker, the app detects the real name when you open it at its `workers.dev` address.
